task: Estimate trifecta rank-pattern frequencies conditional on final quoted price, without selecting a purchase policy.
period: 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30, also report each half-year separately
grouping: that candidate ticket's final odds bin
bin_rationale: Round descriptive reporting ranges, including the previous exacta ranges; extend above100 for trifecta. No return-based tuning or purchase threshold selection.
denominator: All matched complete-book races meeting the cell conditions, including losses of that exact rank-pattern ticket.
interval: 95% Wilson, approximate independent-binomial interval, not a future guarantee
zero_hit_policy: Retain cells with opportunities but no hits and a nonzero uncertainty upper bound.
zero_opportunity_policy: No frequency defined; omit those cells and distinguish from zero hits.
source_validation: Check complete nP3 keys and finite positive quotes, mapped race dates, and winning price versus independent recorded payout. Public export preserves standard combination order. Legacy encrypted archive is uniformly normalized a-b-c -> a-c-b because its parser reverses row-third/column-second labels; verify against independent full books. Quarantine structural/conflicting/payout data mismatches; never choose combination direction per outcome.
limitations: Final prices, no purchase-time snapshot claim.
Frequency within broad groups, not a calibrated individual race probability.
No profitable-cell selection or adoption in this task.
